title: Why Russia Can’t Replace TSMC
summary: Asianometry explains why Russia cannot replace TSMC after sanctions halted chip shipments. It looks at Russian chip designers such as Baikal, MCST and Yadro, and at Russia's lagging domestic manufacturing capacity.
why: HN recommends it in threads about sanctions and Russian military electronics, as an explanation of Russia's semiconductor limits.
